verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user access review feature: no periodic review campaigns, no in-app reviewer sign-off, and no review artifact filed to an evidence library. Integrations that monitor user accounts (GitHub user access, Google Workspace accounts, AWS IAM users) and Fieldwork's scheduled evidence collection are related features, not the access-review workflow itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library
